title: London's High Court dismisses Meta, TikTok, and X's challenge to Ofcom's Online Safety Act information requests, rejecting arguments they were disproportionate (Sam Tobin/Reuters)
summary: Sam Tobin / Reuters: London's High Court dismisses Meta, TikTok, and X's challenge to Ofcom's Online Safety Act information requests, rejecting arguments they were disproportionate — Meta (META.O), TikTok and X lost a legal challenge against British regulator Ofcom on Friday over information requests made under …
